target_pattern: Use subjunctive in relative clauses with que when the referent is non-specific, and use indicative when the referent is specific and identified.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Using the same relative-clause mood regardless of whether the referent is known or unknown.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish marks non-specific desired or searched referents with subjunctive, while known identified referents take indicative.
target_pattern_formula: non-specific referent: indefinite article plus que plus subjunctive
specific referent: definite article plus que plus indicative
common triggers include querer buscar necesitar preferir with non-specific targets
non-specific person templates: busco a alguien que sepa or pueda
natural_examples: Quiero una silla que sea comoda.
Quiero la silla que es comoda.
Busco una casa que de al parque.
Busco la casa que da al parque.
Busco a alguien que pueda ayudarme.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Direct transfer from English relative-clause usage.

common_errors.mistake: Subjunctive used with clearly identified noun
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use indicative for specific identified referents.

common_errors.mistake: Ignoring article contrast una/la or un/el
common_errors.correct_spanish: Article choice often signals mood choice in relative clause.

common_errors.mistake: busco alguien without personal a in standard pattern practice
common_errors.correct_spanish: Busco a alguien is standard and natural.

common_errors.mistake: Using al with non-specific person search
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use indefinite wording for non-specific referents.
Conjugate indicative or subjunctive properly after que.

common_errors.mistake: Mood chosen without checking whether referent is known
common_errors.correct_spanish: Ask if exact referent is identified.

common_errors.mistake: The phrase interpreted as non-specific despite definite article
common_errors.correct_spanish: Definite identified reference usually takes indicative.

common_errors.mistake: Applying subjunctive to all relative clauses by default
common_errors.correct_spanish: Subjunctive here is tied to indefiniteness or uncertainty.

common_errors.mistake: Avoiding this structure from subjunctive anxiety
common_errors.correct_spanish: Make quick specificity decision and then select mood.
